summary: In callable-cli-release-prepare.yml the execution-pair-consumers receiver artifacts (execution-pair-consumer-<case>-<run>-1) are uploaded with retention-days: 14, while the candidate artifact and the installed-proof artifact use 90 days. The forward publisher re-authenticates the four receivers in its preflight and again in the packages job, so preflight and publish must happen before the earliest receiver artifact expires. For consumers run 41152245969 (2026-10-31) the earliest expiry was 2026-11-14T00:51:39Z (fsquint-s1); the publish of 0.3.1 completed in run 41174010005 well inside it. The original 0.3.0 receiver artifacts had already returned HTTP 404 when checked on 2026-10-31, so they cannot be re-read. Lesson: treat the consumers run date plus 14 days as a hard deadline in any forward publication plan, and a lapse requires a new consumers run (and so a new selection), not a rerun. Observation of the cited workflow revision; retention can be changed by the workflow owner or repository settings.
title: Four-receiver artifacts are retained 14 days, setting the forward publish deadline
